text: Cars go by, don't want no one to ever pick me up in sidewalk Look inside, please get the headlights lit Tonight I'll do nothing but stare, and I don't care Black is the color when I gaze up No stars, I don't even need the fucking days up Doesn't matter anyway, cause I just turned them off tonight
